item: Facility, basin and hall master data
what: Names, basin types, areas, depths, perimeters, seasons, hall assignment
method_or_real_anchor: Baederleben Schleswig-Holstein facility survey (Baederleben_SH_Daten_v2.xlsx, not shipped)
assumption_or_note: Only 28.5 % of the water area is measured, 71.5 % uses class defaults; 80 % of the area uses a default depth. The columns area_source, depth_source, perimeter_source and environment_source state the origin of every value
how_to_replace: Edit the tables and set the matching *_source column

what: Indoor or outdoor for 40 basins of combined facilities
method_or_real_anchor: Rule: Schwimmer >= 1000 m2 outdoor else indoor; largest non-swimmer outdoor if outdoor main or natural pool; Sprung/Tauch follow the main pool; Kurs, Warmsprudel, Wellen indoor
assumption_or_note: environment_source = synthetic_rule_kombibad. Indoor against outdoor changes the loss curve by a factor of about 3

method_or_real_anchor: Wave pools 600 m2 x 1.0 m; natural pools 800 and 600 m2 x 1.4 m; Warmsprudel 12 m2 x 0.9 m; Kneipp 6 m2 x 0.4 m; Schulbad Schwimmer depth 1.2 m
how_to_replace: Edit the values and the source column

method_or_real_anchor: Freibad May to September; Kombibad May to September (outdoor basins only); Hallenbad and Schulbad year-round; seasonal Hallenbad Wilster October to April

what: Evaporation activity factor by basin type
method_or_real_anchor: Public 1.0, therapy and diving 0.65, wave 1.75, recreational 0.5

what: Assignment of every facility to the curtailment zone T5 or T6
method_or_real_anchor: UENB section 13k relief regions T5 and T6; Kiel, Flensburg, Ploen, Ostholstein and Herzogtum Lauenburg are in no official region and are assigned to T6
assumption_or_note: Five Kreise outside any official region: the T6 assignment is an assumption
how_to_replace: Verify with the grid operator and edit curtail_zone_id

what: Hourly weather per zone T5 and T6
assumption_or_note: Typical meteorological year relabelled to the 2026 calendar. Not the year of the curtailment series, so wind, heating demand and curtailment do not coincide. The 10 m wind of a reanalysis grid cell is low for the coast
how_to_replace: Use same-year weather (ERA5 or DWD) for coincident analyses and record the source in PROVENANCE.csv

what: Hourly curtailed power per relief zone (MW)
assumption_or_note: One real year. Source year and signal definition (potential or realised curtailment) are still to be documented in PROVENANCE.csv. Resolution hourly, the scheme publishes quarter-hourly values. T6 is merged with Hamburg in the official scheme (config/coordinator_params.csv, T6_hamburg_share)
how_to_replace: Document year and source, add further years for inter-annual variability

method_or_real_anchor: Synthetic profiles scaled by area, opening hours and dwell time
assumption_or_note: Checked against 4 real visitor values (observed over modelled 0.34, 1.14, 0.86, 4.62), scale 1.0. Not calibrated
how_to_replace: Replace with ticket or visitor data and calibrate physics.occupancy_scale

what: Minimum and maximum water temperature per size class and environment
method_or_real_anchor: User-supplied table: sport/diving/wave and non-swimmer 24 to 28 C indoor and 22 to 26 C outdoor; teaching and toddler 28 to 32 C indoor and 22 to 26 C outdoor; warm and whirlpool 34 to 36 C
assumption_or_note: Mapped to size classes by name (Schwimmer, Sprung/Tauch, Wellen/Natur, Nichtschwimmer; Kurs/Lehr, Kleinkind; Warm/Sprudel/Tret). Storage potential is proportional to the band width. Sensitivity axis: system.band_width_k
how_to_replace: Confirm with operator surveys and standards

what: UA, air change, heat recovery, hall air and wall temperatures
method_or_real_anchor: Typical values from the indoor handbook ranges
assumption_or_note: UA 0.0075 to 0.0090 kW/K per m2 water, 1.5 air changes per hour, hall air 29 C, relative humidity 55 %

what: Hall floor area and height per hall (one hall per facility with indoor basins, 55 halls)
method_or_real_anchor: Floor area = indoor water area x 2.0 (water >= 1000 m2) rising to 3.0 (water <= 150 m2); height 6 m
assumption_or_note: No hall areas in the survey. Controls 40 to 60 % of the indoor demand (air side)
how_to_replace: Edit hall_floor_area_m2 and hall_height_m, set source = measured and is_synthetic = 0

what: Reflectance, cloud mode, U-values, evaporation options, air speed
method_or_real_anchor: Handbook defaults (indoor: ashrae evaporation, v_air 0.10 m/s)
assumption_or_note: Documented in the source column. The outdoor wind parameters ro and d_m are Athens calibrations. The evaporation formulation is the largest model-form uncertainty (factor of about 5 between variants)

what: COP(T_air) = carnot_fraction x T_sink / (T_sink - T_source), clipped
method_or_real_anchor: carnot_fraction 0.35, condenser = band mid + 10 K, evaporator = outdoor air - 5 K, cap 4.5; hall coil sink 40 C, cap 4.0
assumption_or_note: Judgement values within the field range of air to water heat pumps. No defrost or part load except aux_el_frac_of_heat
how_to_replace: Use manufacturer curves and run COP +-30 % as a sensitivity

what: Share of the T6 curtailment open to the pools
assumption_or_note: 1.0 overstates the availability because the official T6 region is merged with Hamburg

what: Efficiency, price per MWh of input energy, CO2 factor, capex, O&M, lifetime and needs_installation of the heat sources, of grid and curtailed electricity, of the power-to-heat plants and of the flexibility controller
method_or_real_anchor: Typical German commercial prices 2025/26, UBA emission factors
assumption_or_note: All prices are assumptions. Constant grid price 190 EUR/MWh, curtailed 15 EUR/MWh. The real section 13k terms and a time-varying price are not modelled. The CO2 price is added from settings.yaml
how_to_replace: Replace with real tariffs and contracts

what: Heat sources and heat shares per facility, shares sum to 1 per facility
assumption_or_note: No information on the heating systems of the facilities. Economic results are illustrative
how_to_replace: Survey the facilities, edit the table and set is_synthetic to 0
